mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months indicates tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening windows, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-labor periods, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer and corporate optimism and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor periods, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening aggregate demand, which compresses corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of demand-contraction periods, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 120 for 3 consecutive months indicates a supply-side expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of supply-expansion periods, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in CPIAUCSL inflation above 2% for 3 consecutive months signals a disinflationary trend, lowering discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of disinflation windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly CPIAUCSL inflation above 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates wage-price misalignment, which compresses real earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of misalignment periods, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year period.
